El túnel de los noventa era un ejercicio: The tunnel of the nineties was an exercise in arithmetic: those machines had no fast floating point, so the per-pixel division was precomputed into a table and the effect came down to reading memory. Today the division is free and the effect survives for another reason: it is legible. A tunnel communicates movement and depth immediately, without the viewer having to interpret anything, and that is why it is still on stages, in music videos and in the backdrops of technology conferences.
